findings.detail: The extract has a duplicate CentralSquare First Lien key, while the current-period source schedule contains one such position.

rationale: B02 reports two rows under the same normalized CentralSquare Technologies LLC First Lien key. The raw current-period schedule shows one issuer heading at table 16 row 26 and one corresponding First Lien position at row 27, with a single set of rate, maturity, principal, cost, and fair-value fields. Thus the second extracted key instance is not a distinct source position and is a dimension/identity double count. The raw-source row count is one versus two observed extracted instances.
